role: ABSTRACT BASE — scope-context parent (changed by story-047 + story-048; profiled FULL because all principal accounting + the new global buffer recipient live here since the story-045/046 hoist)
solidityVersion: ^0.8.13 declared; effective >=0.8.20 (OZ v5 Ownable(initialOwner), pauser IPausable ^0.8.20)
purpose: Abstract base for yield-strategy adapters. Since the story-045/046 hoist it owns ALL principal accounting (clientBalances/totalDeposited, deposit/withdraw/relinquish entry points, totalBalanceOf) and exposes the yield source only via hooks (_positionValue/getTotalShares/_acquireShares/_disposeShares/_skimSurplus/_emergencyWithdraw/_totalWithdraw). Story-047 adds a single GLOBAL setAsideBufferRecipient that receives the aggregated set-aside from every client on each skim. Story-048 changes the two-phase totalWithdrawal timing to 6h wait / 72h window.

story-047 (933620d): NEW state: address public setAsideBufferRecipient (default address(0), L63)
NEW setter: setSetAsideBufferRecipient(address) onlyOwner, rejects zero address (L352-357)
SEMANTIC CHANGE (enforced in concretes): set-aside buffers no longer return to each client; they are aggregated into ONE transfer to setAsideBufferRecipient per skim
story-048 (ad12cb1): WithdrawalStatus enum comments updated to match

localFindings.description: The NatSpec for setAsideBufferSize still says the buffer percentage 'is returned to the client instead of going to recipient, giving the client a reserve to absorb below-par dips', and the setSetAsideBuffer AUDITOR NOTE still reasons about a client redirecting buffer 'to itself'. Story-047 changed the flow: ALL clients' set-asides are aggregated into a single transfer to the global setAsideBufferRecipient; no client ever receives its buffer back. A competent owner configuring a per-client buffer from these in-code docs would expect client-reserve semantics and be surprised that the value lands at the global recipient (surprise test passes -> footgun). Documentation-only; code behavior is consistent and loud-guarded.
localFindings.recommendation: Update both NatSpec blocks to describe the aggregated-to-recipient flow and rewrite the front-run-quirk rationale for the new beneficiary.

localFindings.description: Both doc comments still describe a '24-hour waiting period' and '48-hour execution window'; the constants are now 6h/72h (78h total). The enum comments and constant comments WERE updated, these two were missed.

totalWithdrawal's rugpull-protection delay (the documented purpose, L415-416) shrank from 24h to 6h — a 4x reduction in the window the community has to react to an owner-initiated total fund migration — while the owner's execution window widened 48h->72h. Locally this is a parameter choice by a trusted owner (Law 3, not reportable as malice); flagged because the commit message gives no rationale and any downstream component or doc that assumed the 24h guarantee silently loses it. Hand to story-faithfulness: confirm story-048's intent actually covers the security-parameter relaxation and that no sibling doc/story still promises 24h.
localFindings.recommendation: Document the rationale for 6h in the story/docs; confirm no downstream consumer encodes the old 24h assumption.

localFindings.description: Once set, setAsideBufferRecipient can be repointed but never cleared back to address(0) (zero rejected by design to avoid locking tokens). 'Turning off' buffer redirection therefore requires zeroing every client's setAsideBufferSize. Minor operational note; the loud guard makes the unset state safe.
localFindings.recommendation: None required; note in ops runbook.

scannerNotes: skimSurplus return value is now NET of the aggregate set-aside (story-047 keeps the pre-existing 'RETURN VALUE REDUCED by totalSetAside' contract but changes WHO gets the set-aside). Downstream callers (SYA 'yield collected' bookkeeping, stable-staker) must treat the return as recipient-delivered amount only — interaction scanner should re-check consumers against the new beneficiary.

No event reports the aggregate buffer transfer or totalSetAside; observability of the recipient leg relies on the underlying token's Transfer event. story-047 is plausibly the integration half of stable-staker M-05 (set-aside routed to stable-staker as the pro-rata-haircut funding leg) — story-faithfulness should verify against the M-05 deferral record (ledger ss7m5/0dca43f3).
